v1.5.0 — Chrome, macOS & iOS Release!

*Sensory I/O Animations — Added animations and perspective illustrations to show users how SpikerBot will react to stimuli and when driving outputs.

*Remote Control Neurons — New neuron type that allows external sensor input via keyboard and gamepad commands through a binding button. Unbound Remote Control neurons can be collectively triggered with a Remote Trigger button in Live Mode. Remote Control neurons can also receive and send spikes just like a Quiet-type neuron.

*SpikerVision Upgrade — Camera detection model updated to YOLOv8 Nano. Both machine-learned targets and OpenCV colour detection now highlight silhouettes rather than bounding boxes. Added a new dithering algorithm for custom shading.

*Microphone Support — Added volume, frequency, and key/pitch detection as sensory inputs.

*Motor & LED Refractory Period — During simulation, motor and LED outputs now include a refractory period. Signals decay to replicate muscles and chromatophores.

*30 Example Brain Files — Included in-app using all neuron types. Sortable by complexity, name, or date. Filter your files and examples by what I/O or special neurons your brains use.

*Annotations — Each .brain file can now include annotations. Make notes describing sub-functions of neurons and axons within your brain design. Reorder and recall annotations to learn others' designs or remember where you left off.

*Lab Notebook — The Save menu is now the Lab Notebook, showcasing your annotations and notes as you research, study, and experiment. Brain files have been updated visually to show more about your files and examples at a glance.

*Firebase Analytics and Firebase Crashlytics to test the long press in iPhone XR.

*Updated motor code it should move forward/backward if weight is inputted correctly & detecting selected color.
